title_original: Problems with imported IFC from Archicad
question_paraphrase: IFC exported from Archicad and brought into Revit arrives with wrong or generic elements; what settings fix it?
phrasing_notes: plain forum post, version-light, asks for a fix not a concept
answer_summary: Replies point to Graphisoft's Revit add-in Improved IFC Import, linking the result as an RVT and keeping export settings lean; generic fallback happens on complex connections.

title_original: IFC import problem - ceilings, walls
question_paraphrase: After importing an IFC into Revit the ceilings and walls come in wrong (ceilings are IfcCovering and Revit does not read the subtype).
answer_summary: Ceilings translate properly when the IFC is linked into an existing shell file via the Graphisoft add-in; walls behave best as IfcWallStandardCase.

title_original: IFC from Archicad Imported into Revit: Phasing Inconsistencies
question_paraphrase: Renovation project: an existing door, ceiling and roof from Archicad import into Revit as new construction; how do I keep phasing?
phrasing_notes: specific, names the elements that went wrong
answer_summary: No clean fix; phase/renovation status is not reliably carried in IFC, check renovation status mapping on export and re-assign phases in Revit.

title_original: Interoperability issue - Share model with consultants working in Revit
question_paraphrase: I model in Archicad and my consultants are on Revit; what is the right way to share the model with them?
answer_summary: Typical advice: IFC for coordination with the Revit Structure/MEP translator plus the Graphisoft Revit add-in; do not expect a native editable model.

title_original: Archicad 25 elements not converting properly in IFC conversion to Revit
question_paraphrase: Some Archicad 25 elements do not convert correctly when the IFC is opened in Revit.
answer_summary: Check IFC translator, element classification and IFC mapping; use Improved IFC Import add-in.

title_original: Revit IFC to Archicad is fundamentally flawed
question_paraphrase: Revit IFC arrives in Archicad as breps and generic objects; the exchange is fundamentally flawed.
answer_summary: A community expert replies that IFC between the two is meant for coordination and reference, not for handing over an editable design.

title_original: IFC Model Exchange with Archicad for Revit 2024 error
question_paraphrase: Revit crashes when we try to export an IFC after installing the Archicad exchange plugin for Revit 2024.
answer_summary: Uninstalling the plugin restores the native Revit IFC exporter; update to a newer add-in build.

title_original: Problem with IFC export
question_paraphrase: New to Archicad: the IFC export stops around 50% and crashes, also on other PCs; the model has to go to Revit.
phrasing_notes: beginner voice, states what was already tried (other PCs)
answer_summary: Moderator asks for translator used, classification and IFC mapping; try export of parts of the model.

title_original: Issues with exporting Beams from Archicad as IFC into Revit
question_paraphrase: Beams I export from Archicad come into Revit wrongly; a beam drawn with the wall tool exports only after classification is set.
answer_summary: Set classification to Beam and use the Revit Structure translator; slanted columns may arrive as architectural columns.

title_original: EXPORT TO IFC Archicad Elements not exporting
question_paraphrase: Only the stock IFC elements get exported; objects I created myself are missing from the IFC.
answer_summary: Ask which translator was used and update Archicad including RFA/RVT geometry exchange; check element visibility and filter.

title_original: IFC Export Settings and Design Options
question_paraphrase: With design options in Archicad 27, how do IFC export settings handle them so consultants do not get all options?
answer_summary: Use model filters/layer combinations to export only the active option.

gloss_en: IFC export from ArchiCAD for Revit MEP: what else must be considered so building elements are recognised as Revit elements?
title_original: IFC-Export aus ArchiCAD fuer Revit MEP
question_paraphrase: Trotz Revit-Verbindung gibt es Probleme mit dem Modell; was ist beim Export zusaetzlich zu beachten, damit Bauteile in Revit als Revit-Elemente erkannt werden?
phrasing_notes: formal German, uses 'Bauteile', English product names
answer_summary: Check IFC classification and the MEP-oriented export translator.

title_original: Archicad to Revit for MEP: the workaround Graphisoft's own method couldn't give me
question_paraphrase: Graphisoft's own method did not give my MEP consultants a usable model; I found a workaround.
answer_summary: Poster shares a custom workaround; recurring theme is that the official add-in path leaves gaps for MEP.

title_original: IFC and Unwanted Floating Lines from Structural Framing Model Export
question_paraphrase: Linked IFC of the structural framing shows location lines floating on structural framing in my architectural model.
phrasing_notes: describes symptom and where it appears
answer_summary: Location lines follow the framing category when IFC is linked; hide via export option or Revit version fix.

title_original: IFC export option include steel elements messing up columns and framing
question_paraphrase: Ticking 'include steel elements' on IFC2x3 export shifts L-columns and framing by a few cm in Solibri/Navisworks/Revit while plates and bolts stay put.
answer_summary: Autodesk asks to reproduce with default exporter; some say use DWG for full steel LOD.

title_original: Structural columns and structural framing moves after export to IFC
question_paraphrase: Structural columns and framing move position after exporting to IFC.
answer_summary: Check base point / coordinate export option and element offsets.

title_original: Revit 23 to IFC 2x3 wall geometry export issue
question_paraphrase: Wall geometry looks right in IFC4 but wrong in IFC2x3 when exported from Revit 2023.
answer_summary: Geometry representation differs by schema; try IFC4 Reference View if the receiver supports it.

title_original: Is there a final answer as to if Analytical elements can be exported to IFC?
question_paraphrase: Can the analytical model be exported to IFC or not? I want a definitive answer.
phrasing_notes: asks for a 'final answer' after conflicting replies
answer_summary: Mixed answers: physical model exports; analytical needs third-party plug-ins or the Structural Analysis View.

title_original: Revit IFC export configuration and quality control (Revit tip)
question_paraphrase: Which steps before issuing an IFC from Revit: dedicated 3D coordination view, shared parameters as psets, check coordinates, check in a viewer.
answer_summary: Confirm schema with the receiver, use Modify Setup, verify in another viewer because errors are invisible in Revit.

title_original: openBIM bootcamp TOP 10 IFC tips Revit users 2022
question_paraphrase: What are the top ten IFC tips for Revit users exporting for consultants?
answer_summary: Class covering export settings, mapping and property sets.

title_original: IFC Export from ArchiCAD to Revit Structure
question_paraphrase: How to prepare an Archicad model and which translator setting to use for a Revit Structure engineer.
answer_summary: Use the Revit Structure translator; geometry 'Extruded/rotated without connection' by default; full BREP is accurate but not editable.

title_original: IFC exchange Revit <-> ARCHICAD
question_paraphrase: Can I round-trip between Revit and Archicad via IFC and get native elements back?
answer_summary: An Autodesk moderator advises IFC is an export/reference format and conversion back to native Revit elements is limited.

title_original: BlenderBIM: Authoring IFC files for Revit
question_paraphrase: Can I add IfcWallType etc. to an IFC (from old CAD via FME) so Revit opens objects as proper families, not generic models or DirectShapes?
phrasing_notes: goal-first, names the failure mode DirectShape
answer_summary: Types can be added in BlenderBIM or via IfcOpenShell scripting; solid extrusion or typed wall with material layers comes through; round-tripping has a low ceiling.

title_original: BlenderBIM add-on to Archicad workflow
question_paraphrase: How to bridge an IFC authored in Blender into Archicad? Walls with material layer set usage import, openings/windows/doors do not.
answer_summary: Archicad only translates extruded geometry, not BREP; test Archicad-IFC-Archicad first.

title_original: Long-term workflow: BLK360 -> Revit (Fiverr) -> IFC4 -> FreeCAD BIM -> AI-assisted remodeling
question_paraphrase: Revit-generated IFC4 in FreeCAD: are walls/slabs/windows editable BIM objects or static geometry, and is this a sound openBIM strategy?
answer_summary: Editing IFC in FreeCAD is limited; Bonsai recommended; a Revit IFC from a freelancer may be hard to edit.

title_original: IDS and Federated IFC file
question_paraphrase: How should IDS requirements apply to a federated IFC combining several discipline models?
answer_summary: Contributors favour running checks per discipline model with separate reports.

title_original: Exporting with properties or various settings are extremely slow (revit-ifc #492)
question_paraphrase: IFC export from Revit becomes extremely slow when property sets/settings are enabled.
answer_summary: Open issue; reduce property export or split by view.

title_original: Dealing with multiple imports (link) of an updated IFC file (revit-ifc #408)
question_paraphrase: A consultant sends an updated IFC and I re-link it; how do I keep it from duplicating or breaking the link?
answer_summary: Relink by replacing the file path; GUIDs drive updates.

title_original: Incorrect BaseQuantities in Revit 2022.1 (revit-ifc #361)
question_paraphrase: Base quantities (GrossVolume, OuterSurfaceArea, CrossSectionArea) in the Revit IFC are incorrect.
answer_summary: Open issue.

title_original: ENH: Better handling of import class mapping tables (revit-ifc #798)
question_paraphrase: Please improve how IFC import class mapping tables are handled.
answer_summary: Open enhancement.

title_original: Essential Points for Model Quality (CORENET X / IFC-SG)
question_paraphrase: What must architects set before exporting an IFC-SG for Singapore submission: levels, one IfcSite, geo-referencing, gridlines, no duplicate GUIDs.
answer_summary: Align levels/Z-values across disciplines, set coordinates before export, avoid duplicate GUIDs, review clashes first.

gloss_en: How do I prepare a BIM model for a building permit in Geneva?
title_original: Je prepare une maquette BIM (autorisation de construire)
question_paraphrase: Comment preparer et deposer la maquette IFC pour une autorisation de construire a Geneve, avec le Starter Kit et le BIM Checker ?
answer_summary: Two IFC files (deposit model and surveyor template) following the cantonal IFC deposit standard; 8 steps; BIM Checker; guides only for Revit and Archicad.

gloss_en: Which BIM software should an architect pick when the engineering offices refuse IFC and ask for .rvt?
title_original: Quel est le meilleur logiciel BIM en 2026 ?
question_paraphrase: Quel logiciel choisir si mes BET refusent l'IFC et demandent du Revit natif ?
answer_summary: Archicad for permit production with IFC; Revit if BET require native files; IFC does not solve everything.

gloss_en: For the new BIM drawing review, which files do I submit and what causes rejection?
title_original: 第2話：【仕組み】審査の手順と「整合性」の扱い ── BIM図面審査はどう進むのか
question_paraphrase: BIM図面審査では、PDFとIFCを同じモデルから出し、入出力基準適合誓約書を付ける。IFCが表示できないと受理されない？
phrasing_notes: business-blog Japanese, enumerated items, circled-mark jargon
answer_summary: PDF is the formal drawing, IFC is reference but must display; export both from the same model; vague omission notes trigger full visual check; shared origin matters (豆粒問題).

gloss_en: How to output IFC from Archicad in one click with fixed layer sets using saved views and publisher sets.
title_original: 【Archicad】ビュー登録からIFC出力
question_paraphrase: 毎回レイヤーを手作業で設定するのが手間。レイヤーセット+ビュー登録+発行セットでIFCをワンクリック出力したい。
phrasing_notes: practitioner tutorial, layer-set naming (躯体・外装, 内装, 外構)
answer_summary: Create layer sets per export unit, save 3D views, add to a publisher set, choose IFC translator and publish.

gloss_en: Revit export to IFC yields nothing / missing elements: linked models, view range, phase filter.
title_original: revit导出ifc（1）_revit导出ifc没有东西
question_paraphrase: revit导出ifc没有东西，链接模型不会一起导出，视图范围、阶段过滤器会不会把构件裁掉？
phrasing_notes: blog-style Chinese, causes listed as checklist
answer_summary: Export linked files separately, use a dedicated 3D export view, check phase filter and detail level.

gloss_en: Shanghai BIM smart review modelling manual: architectural/MEP use EDM files, IFC mainly for structural load review.
title_original: 上海市工程建设项目BIM智能辅助审查建模手册
question_paraphrase: 报审上海BIM审查：各专业用EDM数据文件还是IFC？IFC只用于结构荷载审查吗？
answer_summary: EDM for architecture/water/HVAC/electrical, IFC mainly for structural load review.

gloss_en: Large Tekla steel IFC links into Revit and it freezes.
title_original: 钢结构模型文件大，输出的IFC文件也比较大，链接进revit中时容易卡掉
question_paraphrase: Tekla导出的钢结构IFC太大，链接进Revit就卡死，怎么办？
answer_summary: Split export by zone and simplify.

gloss_en: Slimming down a Revit model after converting an IFC model to Revit.
title_original: 将IFC模型转换为Revit模型后减肥
question_paraphrase: IFC转成Revit模型后文件很大，怎么瘦身？
answer_summary: Purge unused, remove DirectShapes and import-time garbage.

gloss_en: Export from Tekla to Revit via IFC: only grids arrive.
title_original: Экспорт из Tekla в Revit
question_paraphrase: при экспорте из Tekla в IFC в Revit попадают только оси, элементов не видно
answer_summary: Assign a suitable phase to the linked IFC (phase override in link properties).

gloss_en: Revit-STARK ES link: model export does not happen.
title_original: Связка Revit-STARK ES. Не происходит экспорт модели
question_paraphrase: связка Revit со STARK ES, экспорт модели не происходит
answer_summary: Revit IFC and analytical model are different; analytical model rarely goes via IFC.

gloss_en: How to correctly export a 3D model to IFC; BimSight says System Error on import.
title_original: САПФИР-3D 2020 R2. Как правильно экспортировать модель в IFC?
question_paraphrase: как правильно экспортировать модель в IFC, bimsight выдаёт системную ошибку при импорте
answer_summary: Header showed other generator; Revit opens it, AutoCAD cannot import IFC; no confirmed fix.

gloss_en: From 2019 BIM is mandatory for state projects: is IFC also required and how does Decree 87 apply?
title_original: Нормативные вопросы, связанные с Revit
question_paraphrase: после 1 июля 2019 BIM обязателен для госпроектов; нужно ли сдавать ещё и IFC и PDF, как применять ПП 87?
answer_summary: BIM is a method not a legal requirement; IFC is an exchange format; SP 333.1325800.2017 describes model delivery as agreed with customer.

gloss_en: How is collaborative BIM actually organised in Revit: one shared model or linked models?
title_original: Совместная работа архитектора и конструктора в Autodesk Revit
question_paraphrase: как реально организована совместная работа в Revit, одна общая модель или связи по разделам?
answer_summary: Separate models linked per discipline; IFC for exchange; process and roles matter more than tool.

gloss_en: Exporting a Revit structural model to ETABS via IFC: 'Could not find ENDSEC at end of file'; grids show not exported.
title_original: Como poder exportar un modelo 3D estructural realizado en Revit a ETABS por medio del formato IFC?
question_paraphrase: Tengo un problema al momento de importar mi modelo en ETABS: Could not find ENDSEC at end of file; las grillas aparecen como no exportado
phrasing_notes: student Spanish, error text in English
answer_summary: Forum asks English; suggests truncated file or parser issue, check schema version, encoding and open in an IFC viewer.

gloss_en: How to use the free IFC Model Exchange add-in with Archicad for Revit 2025 (Italian guide).
title_original: IFC Model Exchange with Archicad for Revit 2025 (guida italiana)
question_paraphrase: Come uso il modulo Interscambio di modelli IFC con Archicad per Revit 2025 per esportare e importare IFC migliorato?
answer_summary: Add-in provides export commands and Improved IFC Import.

gloss_en: Open-BIM based building permit research: IFC extracts permit application info for Seumteo; KBim Assess-Lite checks IFC quality.
title_original: BIM기반 건축인허가 (KBim Assess-Lite)
question_paraphrase: BIM 속성정보를 정의하고 IFC에서 인허가 신청정보를 추출해 세움터와 연계하려면 어떻게 하나?
answer_summary: Defines BIM properties for permit application types; IFC to Seumteo extraction; rule-based quality checks.

title_original: Dubai Municipality BIM submission: Frequently Asked Technical Questions
question_paraphrase: How to export the Revit model to IFC for Dubai Municipality submission using the DM BIM template?
answer_summary: Use the DM template and Revit appendix for smoother IFC export; final submission in openBIM IFC.

prompt: sending this to the structural guys in an hour. can you check the ifc - are all columns and beams actually IfcColumn/IfcBeam or did some end up as proxy?
expected_behavior: Count IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcBuildingElementProxy; list proxies with Revit category and type name; flag likely misclassified framing; suggest IfcExportAs fixes.

prompt: consultant's IFC lands 400m away from my model when linked. check its site placement, MapConversion and storey elevations vs ours
expected_behavior: Read IfcSite/IfcMapConversion/IfcProjectedCRS and local placement; compare storey elevations to the architectural model; report offset and suggest base-point alignment.

prompt: engineer sent v3 of the structural IFC, compare with v2 - what walls/columns got added, moved or deleted?
expected_behavior: Match by GlobalId; list added, deleted, moved (placement/geometry diff) and type-changed elements per storey; warn if GUIDs regenerated.

prompt: list all doors and windows in the model with width, height and which wall they sit in, as table. the mep consultant needs it for sleeves
expected_behavior: Query IfcDoor/IfcWindow with Pset/Qto dimensions, follow IfcRelFillsElement/VoidsElement to host wall; output table; note missing dimension properties.

prompt: my structural engineer uses Revit and I use Archicad, what IFC settings should I use so he doesnt have to remodel everything
expected_behavior: Explain Revit Structure translator, classification, Structural Function, geometry as extrusion where possible, linking vs opening, expectation that IFC is reference; offer to check the loaded model against these.

prompt: add Pset_WallCommon FireRating 'EI60' to all internal walls on level 2 and export a fresh IFC for the permit set
expected_behavior: Select IfcWall on storey 2 with IsExternal false; set Pset_WallCommon.FireRating; confirm count and ask before writing; export to new file preserving GUIDs.

prompt: does every IfcSpace have a name, number and area before we upload to the authority portal? list the ones missing
expected_behavior: Iterate IfcSpace, check Name/LongName/Number and NetFloorArea quantity; list missing per storey; flag areas of zero.

gloss_en: Check whether walls, slabs and roof carry correct IFC classes for the structural engineer's model
prompt: kannst du pruefen ob Waende, Decken und Dach als IfcWall/IfcSlab/IfcRoof drin sind und nicht als Proxy? Tragwerksplaner braucht das heute noch
expected_behavior: Count entities by class, list proxies with source types, report predefined types (FLOOR/ROOF), recommend classification fixes.

gloss_en: Which Archicad translator settings so the engineer can use the model in Revit
prompt: welchen Uebersetzer nehm ich fuer den Statiker mit Revit? Tragende Bauteile muessen als Struktur erkannt werden
expected_behavior: Explain Revit Structure translator, structural function, load-bearing flag; if model loaded, check Pset_*Common LoadBearing values.

gloss_en: Count how many elements in the model became proxies and from which Revit categories
prompt: глянь сколько в ифс проксей и из каких категорий ревита, конструкторам надо отдать нормально
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by Revit category/ObjectType, suggest mapping or IfcExportAs changes.

gloss_en: Check storey names and elevations against the structural model before submission for expertise
prompt: проверь этажи и отметки в модели, чтобы совпадали с КР, завтра сдача на экспертизу
expected_behavior: Read IfcBuildingStorey names and Elevation, compare with reference model or list for inconsistency, flag duplicated names.

gloss_en: Check rooms and area properties before BIM review submission
prompt: 报审前帮我查下IFC里房间有没有编号和面积，缺的列出来
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with missing Name/Number/area; report by storey.

gloss_en: Why is my exported IFC empty or missing elements
prompt: revit导出的ifc打开啥都没有 链接模型也没出来 咋回事
expected_behavior: Explain linked model export, view range, phase filter; if IFC loaded, report entity counts and bounding boxes.

gloss_en: Give concrete volume by storey for structural engineer
prompt: dame el volumen de hormigon por planta de columnas y forjados del IFC, para pasarselo al ingeniero
expected_behavior: Filter by material concrete, sum NetVolume per storey for IfcColumn/IfcSlab, flag missing quantities.

gloss_en: Check classes before sending to structural engineer
prompt: confere ai se as vigas e pilares estao como IfcBeam e IfcColumn antes de mandar pro calculista
expected_behavior: Count by class, list proxies, report type names, suggest remap.

gloss_en: Check mandatory parameters for the permit model
prompt: peux-tu verifier que les murs et dalles ont bien les proprietes obligatoires pour le depot de permis (norme IFC de depot) ?
expected_behavior: Check requested psets per object type and list missing; acknowledge requirements come from the cantonal standard and ask for the list if not given.

gloss_en: Check origin and display issues before BIM drawing review
prompt: 確認申請に出すIFC、原点が測量座標から遠くないか意匠・構造・設備でズレてないか見て
expected_behavior: Compare placements across disciplines, report distance from survey origin, flag mismatched storeys.

gloss_en: How to export IFC for building permit
prompt: 인허가용 IFC 내보내기 할 때 어떤 변환 설정 써야 돼요? 세움터에 올릴 건데
expected_behavior: Explain translator choice and that exact requirement must be checked with the authority; offer to check loaded model's property completeness.

gloss_en: Compare consultant IFC versions
prompt: confronta l'ultimo IFC dello strutturista con quello di ieri, cosa e' cambiato su pilastri e travi?
expected_behavior: Diff by GlobalId, report added/removed/moved columns and beams.
